briefing: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
summary: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
briefing: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.

title: Base completes Cobalt upgrade, adds new tools for tokenized assets
summary: Base completes Cobalt upgrade, adds new tools for tokenized assets
briefing: Base’s Cobalt lets traders set transaction conditions while giving issuers tools for compliance checks, stock splits and forced token transfers.

title: Bloomberg brings onchain stablecoin data to its Terminal
summary: Bloomberg brings onchain stablecoin data to its Terminal
briefing: Bloomberg’s Allium-powered dashboard gives Terminal users hourly data on stablecoin supply, issuance, transfers and activity across blockchain networks.

title: Brazil’s Petrobras uses Cardano to track sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel
summary: Brazil’s Petrobras uses Cardano to track sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel
briefing: Petrobras developed two Cardano-based applications to track sustainability claims tied to aviation fuel and renewable diesel as part of an ongoing research collaboration.

title: Bitget ‘gradually back to usual’ as protection fund reaches $309M
summary: Bitget ‘gradually back to usual’ as protection fund reaches $309M
briefing: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said that a protection fund created by the company in 2022 “absorbed the financial impact of the incident“ that resulted in $388 million in user losses.

title: Could THORChain face prosecution over stolen Bitget funds?
summary: Could THORChain face prosecution over stolen Bitget funds?
briefing: THORChain will not — or can not — block addresses linked to the $387.5 million Bitget hack. Can the devs be prosecuted for money laundering? It’s complicated, says crypto lawyer Yuriy Brisov.

title: Singapore crypto activity grows 55% as broader region contracts
summary: Singapore crypto activity grows 55% as broader region contracts
briefing: Singapore’s crypto economy grew 55.4% to $284 billion as institutional-platform activity surged 94%, while the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam stood out for small-value P2P transfers.

title: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
summary: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
briefing: The attacker behind the $387.5 million Bitget heist has started hiding about $3.8 million in ZEC inside Zcash's Ironwood pool, after Near Intents turned their swaps away.

title: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
summary: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
briefing: Ask the U.S. government's new AI chatbot about Minecraft and it produces a roughly 1,800-word bureaucratic remix of the game's ending poem. It's an easter egg, not a hallucination.

title: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
summary: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
briefing: The two proposals would define event contracts as "swaps" while excluding "casino-style gambling products"—a bid to cement the agency's exclusive jurisdiction as states sue prediction-market operators over gambling claims.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Extend Win Streak to 9 Days, Matching August Rally
summary: Bitcoin ETFs Extend Win Streak to 9 Days, Matching August Rally
briefing: Bitcoin ETFs added $66 million Tuesday, matching August's nine-day run and topping it in dollars. How long will the streak stay alive?

summary: Introducing The Information Exchange on Solana, Powered by Decrypt and MYR
briefing: Decrypt is the destination, Myriad is the infrastructure and MYR is the token for a connected media ecosystem.

summary: Trump Unveils 'Morally Binding' AI Accord Signed by OpenAI, Google and Nvidia
briefing: The one-page pact, which Trump called "morally binding," asks companies to adopt internal controls, independent audits and board oversight—but carries no penalties and drew criticism for its thin detail.

title: Bitcoin Jumps on Cool PCE Inflation Data as Bond Yields Hit 20-Year Highs
summary: Bitcoin Jumps on Cool PCE Inflation Data as Bond Yields Hit 20-Year Highs
briefing: The Fed's favorite inflation gauge came in cooler than expected, rate-hike odds fell and Bitcoin traders took the hint.

title: Ex-NCA Officer Must Repay $2.4M for Bitcoin He Stole When It Was Worth $77K
summary: Ex-NCA Officer Must Repay $2.4M for Bitcoin He Stole When It Was Worth $77K
briefing: Paul Chowles took 50 BTC from a Silk Road 2.0 seizure in 2017. Prosecutors have now valued the theft at more than 30 times that.
